about_the_game:
K-Pop Combat

Swing your trusty double cleaver in stylized light and heavy attack combos, inspired by K-Pop choreography.

Trick or Treat Attacks

Attack enemies to fill up your fright meter. Use your fright power to scare enemies into dropping their candy or use for special attacks. 

Parry With Your Candy

Shoot colorful jawbreaker candy before an enemy attack to parry. Follow up with an attack to deal bonus damage. Candy has never been so deadly!

Fast-Paced Action

Perform swift dodges and dashes to avoid enemy attacks. Manage your stamina and distance from the enemy to land attacks.

K-Pop M/V Cutscenes

Cutscenes and Boss fights feature original songs and choreography, animated in a fun K-Pop music video style.

name: Trickington Hollow

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600k Processor / AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: A K-Pop, Halloween souls-like boss rush game. Swing your cleaver in stylish attacks, parry with candy, and trick or treat your way to victory. Take down bosses to original songs. Save the land of Trickington from the Grim Reaper and his minions.
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Korean*
*languages with full audio support
